blurb: Where the Nanopore community gathers, and lists maintained by others that go deeper than this page.

items.name: awesome-nanopore
items.desc: Curated list of Nanopore tools, datasets and papers maintained by the Göke lab.

items.name: Nanopore Community
items.desc: Oxford Nanopore's official forum, software downloads (Guppy, MinKNOW) and protocols. Free account required.

items.name: EPI2ME
items.desc: Oxford Nanopore's analysis platform and workflow catalogue, with example datasets.

items.name: EPI2ME Labs data index
items.desc: Index of Oxford Nanopore Open Data releases: public example runs across applications and chemistries.

items.name: Oxford Nanopore Open Data on AWS
items.desc: Raw and basecalled Open Data hosted in the AWS Open Data registry.

items.name: Biostars
items.desc: Bioinformatics question-and-answer site with an active Nanopore community.

blurb: Containers for the raw current signal and the reference k-mer models that most tools build on.

items.name: POD5 file format
items.desc: Current Oxford Nanopore raw-signal format and Python/C++ API; replaces fast5.

items.name: ont_fast5_api
items.desc: Read, write and convert single- and multi-read fast5 files.

items.name: SLOW5 / slow5tools
items.desc: Community-designed compact signal format with fast random access, plus conversion tools.

items.name: ONT k-mer models
items.desc: Expected current level and spread per k-mer for each pore chemistry; used for event alignment and evaluation.

items.name: Taiyaki file formats
items.desc: Documentation of fast5 attributes and the raw-to-picoampere conversion.

blurb: Production basecallers from Oxford Nanopore and research models from the community.

items.name: Dorado
items.desc: Oxford Nanopore's current basecaller: DNA/RNA models, modified-base calling, polyA estimation, duplex.

items.name: Bonito
items.desc: PyTorch research basecaller from Oxford Nanopore; the reference for training your own models.

items.name: Rerio
items.desc: Research release models for Dorado and Bonito, including modified-base models.

items.name: Remora
items.desc: Training and inference framework for modified-base detection on top of basecalling.

items.name: RODAN
items.desc: Fully convolutional RNA basecaller from the research community.

items.name: Causalcall
items.desc: Temporal convolutional network basecaller for DNA.

blurb: Mapping reads to a reference and aligning the raw signal to k-mers, the inputs to every downstream task.

items.name: minimap2
items.desc: Standard long-read aligner; map-ont and splice presets for Nanopore DNA and RNA.

items.name: Nanopolish
items.desc: Signal-level toolkit: eventalign, polya, methylation calling.

items.name: f5c
items.desc: GPU-accelerated re-implementation of Nanopolish eventalign and call-methylation.

items.name: Tombo
items.desc: Re-squiggle algorithm and modified-base detection on raw signal (legacy, still widely used).

items.name: Uncalled4
items.desc: Signal alignment and visualisation toolkit with DTW-based event alignment and k-mer model training.

items.name: SegPore
items.desc: Raw signal segmentation and event alignment for direct RNA, with modification state estimation.

items.name: squigulator
items.desc: Simulate raw Nanopore signal from a reference, useful for testing segmentation and basecalling.

blurb: Tools that call m6A, m5C, pseudouridine and other marks from direct RNA signal or basecalling errors.

items.name: m6Anet
items.desc: Multiple-instance learning m6A detector on Nanopolish eventalign output.

items.name: xPore
items.desc: Differential modification detection between conditions from signal distributions.

items.name: CHEUI
items.desc: m6A and m5C detection at single-molecule resolution with CNNs.

items.name: EpiNano
items.desc: Modification detection from basecalling error features.

items.name: Nanocompore
items.desc: Comparative signal analysis between two samples to find modified sites.

items.name: ELIGOS
items.desc: Error-of-specific-bases method; source of the eligos datasets in NanoBaseLib.

items.name: modkit
items.desc: Oxford Nanopore's toolkit for summarising modified-base calls (MM/ML tags) from Dorado BAMs.

blurb: Quality control, read statistics and small utilities you will reach for in every project.

items.name: tailfindr
items.desc: Alignment-free poly(A) tail length estimation from raw fast5 for RNA and DNA.

items.name: NanoPlot / NanoPack
items.desc: Read-length and quality plots for sequencing summaries, FASTQ and BAM.

items.name: pycoQC
items.desc: Interactive QC reports from Guppy/Dorado sequencing summaries.

items.name: samtools / htslib
items.desc: Sort, filter and index BAM files; the glue between every pipeline step.

items.name: seqkit
items.desc: Fast FASTA/FASTQ manipulation toolkit.

blurb: End-to-end pipelines that chain the tools above.

items.name: nf-core/nanoseq
items.desc: Nextflow pipeline for Nanopore DNA/RNA: basecalling, alignment, quantification, modification calling.

items.name: EPI2ME Labs workflows
items.desc: Oxford Nanopore's open-source wf-* Nextflow workflows (e.g. wf-transcriptomes, wf-human-variation).

items.name: Master of Pores
items.desc: Nextflow workflow for direct RNA preprocessing, modification and polyA analysis.

items.name: NanoBaseLib pipeline
items.desc: The unified six-step preprocessing pipeline used for every dataset on this site.

blurb: Where raw Nanopore data lives, and other benchmark collections.

items.name: NanoBaseLib raw data index
items.desc: Direct fast5 download links and accessions for all 44 samples in NanoBaseLib.

items.name: NanoBaseLib on Zenodo
items.desc: Processed data and benchmark archives, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.10889896.

items.name: European Nucleotide Archive (ENA)
items.desc: Primary archive for PRJEB/PRJNA projects; raw Nanopore submissions include fast5/pod5 tarballs.

items.name: NCBI Sequence Read Archive (SRA)
items.desc: Raw sequencing data archive; mirrors ENA submissions.

items.name: SG-NEx
items.desc: Singapore Nanopore Expression project: matched direct RNA, cDNA and short-read data for human cell lines.

items.name: NA12878 Nanopore WGS Consortium
items.desc: Human genome and native RNA reference datasets with raw fast5.

blurb: Reviews and benchmarks that give the big picture.

items.name: Nanopore sequencing technology, bioinformatics and applications
items.desc: Wang et al., Nature Biotechnology 39, 1348–1365 (2021). The standard review of the technology and its analysis landscape.

items.name: NanoBaseLib paper
items.desc: Cheng, Fu & Cheng, NeurIPS 2024 Datasets and Benchmarks Track.

items.name: Oxford Nanopore publications
items.desc: Oxford Nanopore's resource centre: application notes, posters, talks and the publication database.
